limitations: Sound-driver-only extraction: RAM setup selects individual queues; no gameplay or learned-policy claim.
WAVs are libgme's digital APU rendering, not an analog NES recording or a bit-perfect hardware claim.
Long recurring scores are 180-second captures. Exact intro/loop endpoints and seamless WAV looping are unmeasured.
One-shot tails use an explicit amplitude threshold; their exact native score termination frame is unmeasured.
Queue labels follow the cited disassembly symbols, bound to this exact ROM and engine signature; contextual combinations are not exhaustively enumerated.
Accelerated area variants initialize the driver's native note-length selector; their separate hurry jingle is exported as event_hurry.
FFT and sample checks do not establish subjective or analog perceptual identity; no human listening claim is made.
